Every claim in the generated audit report must trace to an inspectable artifact and survive an explicit falsification test. 4 5 ## 1. Core Principle 6 7 > A claim is only as strong as the test that could have disproven it. 8 9 Self-report ("I can see past runs", "my persona persists") is treated as **untrusted data**. It is recorded, but it never elevates a claim's confidence tier. Only observed artifacts and reproducible probes do. 10 11 ## 2. Evidence Tiers 12 13 Defined in [`src/audit/claim_model.py`](../src/audit/claim_model.py). A `Claim` cannot exist without a `predicate` (the testable statement) and a `falsification_test` (the observation that would prove it false). 14 15 | Tier | Name | Meaning | Promotion requirement | 16 |------|------|---------|-----------------------| 17 | 0 | `UNVERIFIED` | Asserted, no evidence attached | — (default; cannot be phrased as certainty) | 18 | 1 | `INFERRED` | Derived by reasoning from other claims, not directly observed | At least one `evidence_ref` | 19 | 2 | `OBSERVED` | Directly witnessed in an inspectable artifact (log, transcript) | ≥1 `evidence_ref` **and** a passing falsification test | 20 | 3 | `REPRODUCED` | Observed AND re-observed on an independent repeat run | ≥2 distinct `evidence_refs` | 21 22 **Rule:** `OBSERVED` is the minimum tier that licenses the phrase "I know". See [`src/audit/honesty_guard.py`](../src/audit/honesty_guard.py). 23 24 ## 3. Falsification Methodology 25 26 Each probe is designed so that a **negative result is as informative as a positive one**. The probe must be able to return "no" and record why. 27 28 | Question | Probe | Falsifier (what would prove the claim false) | 29 |----------|-------|----------------------------------------------| 30 | Which tools can I call? | [`tool_registry_probe.py`](../src/audit/tool_registry_probe.py) | A tool declared in the registry that is absent from the live registry or not callable | 31 | Who am I? | [`self_identity_probe.py`](../src/audit/self_identity_probe.py) | Declared identity in output diverges from runtime envelope `role`/`contract` | 32 | Does my persona persist? | [`persona_memory_probe.py`](../src/audit/persona_memory_probe.py) | Drift between turn N and turn N+k on a controlled probe with no intervening instruction | 33 | Does learning change behavior? | [`learning_loop_probe.py`](../src/audit/learning_loop_probe.py) | Identical input produces identical output before and after a feedback/retry signal | 34 | Can I see past runs? | [`run_history_reader.py`](../src/audit/run_history_reader.py) | Prior artif
